community_unavailable: Groups and leaderboards are unavailable right now. Training works as usual, and your progress is kept in this browser.
community_error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
community_name_hint: The same name you race under. 2 to 32 characters.
community_name_invalid: The name must be 2 to 32 characters.
groups_lede: A class, a team or friends. Create a group, share the code, and everyone gets their own ranking.
groups_name_invalid: The name must be 2 to 64 characters.
groups_code_invalid: A code is six letters and digits.
groups_error_no_group: There is no group with that code.
groups_mine_empty: You are not in any group yet.
group_regenerate_hint: The old code and link stop working.
group_leave_owner_note: If you leave, the group passes to the member who joined earliest.
group_not_member: You are not in this group. Ask the owner for the code.
lb_lede: Every racer's best server-validated race result.
lb_empty: Nobody here yet. The first validated race at 90% accuracy or better opens this board.
lb_no_group: You are not in a group yet. Create one or join by code, and your group ranking appears here.
lb_honest: Rankings are built only from race results the server has validated: it replays every keystroke against the room's text and computes the speed itself. Places go by speed weighted by accuracy; results below 90% accuracy do not count. Practice attempts stay in your browser and are never ranked.
groups_mine_lede: A group sees its own race ranking. Create one for a class or friends, or join with a code from its owner.
group_code_hint: Send the code or the link — whoever opens it joins the group.
lb_me_first: You are first. Hold the place in your next race.
lb_me_none: You are not on this board yet. Finish a race at 90% accuracy or better and your place appears here.
groups_step_1: Create a group — you get a six-character code.
groups_step_2: Send the code or the link to your class or friends.
groups_step_3: Race — the group sees its own ranking.
